facts.raw_span: a 2-year history of hip pain following low-impact falls
stress fractures of the left rib, left sacrum, and left femoral neck
elevated alkaline phosphatase level of 220 U/L
phosphorus level of 2.1 mg/dL
25-OH vitamin D 14.8 ng/mL
FGF23 1241 RU/mL
Bone densitometry showed Z-scores of −2.5 in the lumbar spine and −1.9 in the femoral neck
a slow gait with a limp and lumbar tenderness
alkaline phosphatase 204 U/L
phosphorus 1.6 mg/dL
a 9×8-mm intracortical lesion in the anterolateral right fibular head

concepts.why: Patient has hypophosphatemia, elevated FGF23, and stress fractures, which are characteristic of X-linked hypophosphatemia.
Patient has elevated alkaline phosphatase, low 25-OH vitamin D, and low 1,25[OH]2D3, which are indicative of osteomalacia.
Patient has stress fractures, low bone density, and an intracortical lesion, which are consistent with fibrous dysplasia.
Patient has hypophosphatemia, elevated FGF23, and bone pain, which are characteristic of hypophosphatemic rickets.
Patient has low 25-OH vitamin D, low 1,25[OH]2D3, and elevated alkaline phosphatase, which are indicative of vitamin D deficiency.
Patient has low bone density, stress fractures, and bone pain, which are consistent with osteoporosis.
Patient has hypophosphatemia, elevated FGF23, and abnormal kidney function, which are characteristic of chronic kidney disease.
Patient has elevated alkaline phosphatase, low 25-OH vitamin D, and low 1,25[OH]2D3, which are indicative of rickets.
